projection.model: rho(n') = S_top*sqrt(2^(3n')/h), S_top = mean S of the top two rho rungs; F = fb_ratio*2^n'; targets = F*K*(c+a)/(1-(1-a)^3), a = fs/F, fitted on unsaturated D2S/D2S23 rows with F >= 256; relation + graph = targets*(alpha + beta*n' + g); LA either 2^l0*fs^gamma (fit, fs >= 256) or kappa*fs^2 (gamma fixed at 2); frozen rules and fs re-optimised at each n'
